messages:
emma: Heads up — security request: we need to tighten HSM operator permissions for BYOK customers. Current role grants `hsm:admin` to ops and it's too broad.
raj: Agreed. Can we map out the exact actions operators actually need? I think only import, wrap/unwrap, and set maintenance windows.
jordan: Quick inventory: operators perform import (one-off), firmware patch orchestration, emergency key escrow, and diagnostic access.
maria: For compliance we should also capture who triggered each action in audit logs + reason field. SOC2 will expect rationale.
emma: Proposal: split `hsm:admin` into `hsm:import`, `hsm:maintain`, `hsm:diagnostic`. Restrict `hsm:escrow` to a dedicated oncall role with two-person approval.
ops-oncall: Two-person approval for escrow is doable, but we need a tooling flow. Can we use the existing `keystore-proxy` + an approval webhook?
raj: Yes — implement a short-lived escalation token issued only after 2/3 approval in PagerDuty. Token TTL 10m. ops-oncall: That works operationally. Add audit event with PD incident id.
jordan: Audit logging: ensure logs include `actor`, `role`, `action`, `key-id`, `request-id`, and `justification` if provided. Also immutable append-only log to S3 + KMS-encrypt manifest.
maria: For regulated customers (PCI/SOC2) we need retention 7 years? check control mapping. I'll ping legal.
emma: Also question: KMS integration path for private deployments — customers want BYOK with HSM-backed CMKs. How do we verify attestation without sending keys off-prem?
raj: Recommend using PKCS#11 attestation signatures. Customer proves HSM attestation blob; we verify signature against vendor root. No key material leaves HSM.
ordan: Add a verification step in onboarding: `verify_attestation(hsm_blob) -> vendor_chain_ok && nonce_ok`. Save attestation hash in our audit log.
security-bot: Reminder: CVE triage kickoff @channel tomorrow 10:00am — include HSM firmware vuln backlog in pre-read.
emma: Speaking of vuln triage — we had a third-party report for an HSM firmware issue that could allow local privilege escalation during maintenance mode. Any mitigation short-term?
raj: Immediate mitigations: 1) restrict maintenance windows to isolated mgmt network, 2) require MFA for maintenance console, 3) apply vendor patch in staged canary.
ordan: Also add network-level egress block from HSM mgmt plane except vendor endpoints.
maria: Documenting for compliance: create control narrative that ties RBAC changes + telemetry collection + maintenance controls to SOC2 CC6/CC7. I'll draft.
emma: Action items: (1) raj opens PR for role definitions + IAM policy (2) ops-oncall wires PD approval token flow (3) jordan adds new audit fields to keystore-proxy logs (4) maria drafts control narrative by EOD Fri.
ops-oncall: I'll start PD runbook and mock the token issuance endpoint.
raj: PR will include migration script to map current `hsm:admin` users to least-privilege roles and an opt-out for 72h.
emma: One more: add a daily report to security Slack with any `hsm:escrow` attempts and approvals. security-bot: Scheduled report configured for weekdays 08:00 UTC.
maria: I'll add compliance checklist item: attestation hash retention, escrow approval logs, and patch evidence.
emma: Thanks — let's reconvene after PR and runbook drafts. :thumbsup:
